verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Slack shipping its own official MCP *server* (docs-2, docs-28, probe-3, probe-6) so other AI clients can call Slack's tools — the reverse direction of this story. There is no evidence that Slack itself acts as an MCP client, letting users plug external MCP servers into Slack so its AI features (Slackbot, agents) can call those servers' tools. Missing for 10: any documentation of Slack consuming/connecting to third-party MCP servers, a settings UI or API for registering external MCP servers, or first-party/community confirmation that Slack's AI agents can invoke tools from arbitrary MCP servers.
